# Never-loaded gap between sec4 and sec5

428 KiB of the image that no section load covers; fenykl reads FENYKL.BIN here and puts the loader stack after it.

**Category:** free space · **Address:** `0x60da5000` to `0x60e10000` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M10 Mark II firmware 1.4, build 1400](../firmware/em10-ii-1400.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 Mark II](../cameras/em10-ii.md)

Free RAM, not free file space; bytes put here in the update file are never loaded. fenykl uses 0x60da5000 to 0x60e0c000 for the payload (at most 0x67000 bytes with its header) and 0x60e0c000 to 0x60e10000 for the loader task's stack. The section-load guard covers it until section_wait has run for sec4 and sec5.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): Described as the never-loaded gap between sec4 and sec5, with the payload load address and size limit. Source: [fenykl E-M10 Mark II target description](../sources/fenykl.target.md).
- **Static analysis** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): The loader waits for the sec4 and sec5 loaded bits, after which the load guard starts at 0x61010000 and no longer covers this range. Source: [fenykl loader source for E-M10 Mark II 1.4](../sources/fenykl.loader-source.md).
- **Physical camera** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): Plugins loaded and run from this range work on the maintainer's camera. Source: [fenykl plugin SDK](../sources/fenykl.sdk.md).

**[Full detail upstream](https://github.com/atx/fenykl/blob/dd8dde0ead63bfc2a722f65a7b86e19577ad9778/sdk/README.md#payload-rules)**
